stores.title: How this is read
stores.p1: One row per store, summed from Stock Visibility's stock rows at storage location 0001. Stock is the till-side counter: SAP's counter less the till sales SAP has not posted yet. SAP stock is SAP's own counter, and the gap is SAP stock less till-side stock — sold at the till, not in SAP yet.
stores.p2: Held is every hold not released, in two parts: standing holds, and holds sold at the till whose sale is not applied to the counter yet (sold not applied).
stores.p3: Reserved is the reserved recompute's total for the store. If the recompute has never run it says "not computed", never zero. If its last success is older than 15 minutes it is marked stale, with its time.
stores.p4: Free is till-side stock less held less reserved, not floored at zero. While reserved is not computed, free is till-side stock less held and says "reserved not included". Every figure is a sum across items, in base units.
stores.p5: The status is the worst of the store's flags: no SAP document for over 24 hours, a standing hold older than 2 days, a sale not applied for over 2 hours, items below zero, a differing nightly comparison, stock on placeholder batches. Each is a Watch, except over 500 items below zero, or any item below zero or a differing comparison in a store in Blocking, which are a Problem. The list is a copy at most a minute old; Refresh reads it again.
